scene: You step off the paint-splattered tram into bustling Mural Mile.
picture: Side-scrolling view along a flat pavement. On the far left stands tall bamboo scaffolding with hanging buckets. The paint-splattered tram sits left of centre with open doors. The teenage Pacific Islander girl stands centre holding her sketchbook. Up high hovers a yellow paint drone, and on the right gleams a shifting mural wall.
shown: Tall bamboo scaffolding with a hanging rope ladder on the far left
A yellow twin-rotor spray-can drone hovering up high above the street
A vibrant digital pixel wall shifting into fresh violet patterns on the right
